title: BMW Personal Assistant Frustrations
summary: Feedback centers on the BMW personal assistant, with clear complaints about poor performance and several fragments that mention the feature without enough context for a firm sentiment.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe the personal assistant as frustrating and worse than the previous virtual assistant.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention the personal assistant and a possible failure to switch drive mode on request, but the sample does not provide enough context to classify all of them confidently.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are very short or incomplete, which limits confident interpretation.
The topic is narrow but evidence for some mentions lacks enough context to separate undetermined from clearly negative feedback.
Samples are stratified and not representative of all reviews for this topic.
